name: Which cuFile release refuses the direct path on FSx for Lustre: the same strict read with each libcufile on the host

tasks.name: one 8 GiB file on /fsx for GPU 0
commands: [ -f /fsx/gdsio/f0 ] || dd if=/dev/urandom of=/fsx/gdsio/f0 bs=16M count=512 oflag=direct status=none

tasks.name: gdsio and KvikIO, strict config, LD_PRELOAD of each libcufile; the cuFile log says which release ran and whether it chose compat
